cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm just a spare pair of hands. Put the cupboard door down for a moment; we're not fitting it while the frame leans like that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Leave them open at the hinges. I'll hold the frame square, then we'll do the door. No need to make a project of my visit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the door for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Say 'I need your help with the door', and I'll hold it while you fit the hinges.
